name: Kenco MCS Perris II - Perris CA

fieldNotes.site: Perris I (idx 5) and Perris II (idx 6) both resolve to the Kenco Perris Logistics Center campus, 3900 Indian Avenue, SE corner of Ramona Expressway / Indian Avenue. Public sources list one 579,708 SF building; the campus actually holds two large cross-dock warehouses. idx 5 point landed on the north building, so Perris II was audited as the SOUTH building (the larger of the two), centered ~33.8392, -117.2303.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Truck yard is fully enclosed by black metal perimeter fence (confirmed in 5+ Street View headings off Indian Avenue and the west perimeter road). Facility is C-TPAT certified per LogiCore listing, which mandates a controlled, secured yard. A gate exists; exact arm/slide-gate not crisply resolvable from imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible in any Street View of the perimeter or truck-drive entrances. Modern Class-A Inland Empire spec building; access is consistent with a sliding gate plus kiosk/intercom (remote check-in).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock building - distinct dock banks on the north face and the south face.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock: ~55 doors on the south face and ~55 on the north face; total estimated ~110 (50+ band).
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large shared trailer drop yard between the two campus buildings, packed with parked trailers; also trailer parking along south apron.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Two large warehouse buildings (Perris I and Perris II) on the same fenced campus.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck-yard drives and a deep apron at the NW entrance provide room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~30 acres for the south building parcel; matches reported 28-30 acre Perris Logistics Center site.
